action.objective: Verify b1c3 (the reserved broad-search suggestion) at maximum depth with the reserved node allowance before committing.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search over all 20 legal moves rated b1c3 best (score 52, exact bound) via Nc3, e.g. 1...Nc6 2.Nf3. It develops a minor toward the center and keeps castling open, unlike the other top rows which carry 'upper' bounds. No commit_ready moves exist yet, so this single-candidate verification at max depth is required; deviating without verification would rely on shallower or bounded evidence.
